exactCanonicalSetting.sourceObservedSetting: preparation.minimum_spacing: remove surveys less than 30 minutes after the previous survey answer

inputBoundary: One caller-supplied finite nonnegative elapsed duration in minutes from the previous experience-sampling survey answer to the candidate survey answer.
outputBoundary: Remove a candidate answer when the supplied gap is strictly less than 30 minutes and retain it at equality or above.
limitations: The released analysis invokes filter_kurzbefragung but does not include that helper's implementation; this binding executes only the explicitly documented gap predicate.
Participant partitioning, timestamp parsing, answer ordering, selection of the previous answer, duplicate handling, and iterative versus single-pass behavior occur upstream.
The source reports 15,699 rows before and 15,682 after filtering, but the private input rows needed to replay that aggregate oracle are unavailable.
No integer rounding, timestamp resolution, clock, timezone, or tolerance policy is inferred.
Missing, negative, or nonfinite elapsed duration fails closed instead of being treated as zero or retained.
